eff_param_list_help: Order of the list = order of setting. The first parameter is set first and is the fastest (innermost) sweep.
eff_set: This parameter is set on an instrument
eff_set_help: Call that sets the value. Leave off for a read-only parameter (for example a shunt).
eff_reads_help: Each reading is available in formulas as name@label.
eff_verify: Check that the value was applied
eff_verify_help: After setting, the chosen reading must match the set value.
eff_output_help: Calls that switch the output of this instrument on and off.
eff_out_keep_on: on during the measurement, off at the end
eff_out_help_keep_on: Switched on at the start and off at the end of the measurement.
eff_out_help_off_during_cooldown: As above, and switched off while waiting between sweeps.
eff_out_help_always_on: Switched on first if it is off, and never switched off by the measurement, even after an error or a stop.
eff_renamed_formulas: {n} formula(s) updated with the new name
eff_timing_help: Waiting and averaging for every point.
eff_cooldown_help: The cooldown is only waited when the innermost sweep starts again, never after the last point.
eff_formulas_help: Results computed from the mean of the readings. Double-click a name on the right to insert it.
eff_power_help: Order in which the outputs are switched on. Outputs set to 'always on' are not listed: they are switched on first.
eff_power_none: No parameter switches an output yet: tick 'Output switching' in the Parameters tab.
eff_startup_help: Run once before the measurement (for example reset, or set a mode).
eff_shutdown_help: Run once after the measurement, also after an error or a stop.
eff_problems_title: Problems: {errors} error(s), {warnings} warning(s) - double-click to go to the field
eff_summary_invalid: Cannot start yet: {errors} error(s) to fix
eff_save_with_errors: There are {errors} error(s): the measurement cannot start until they are fixed. Save anyway?
